claim_semantics.definition: CLAIMED / ZDA means: this portfolio formally records Juri Janovski / Juri Halveth's evidence-backed claim that the demonstrated work maps to the named benchmark. It is a self-asserted portfolio claim, not a statement that the third-party issuer awarded the credential.
